candidates.description: This vector represents common German action verbs in their base and inflected forms.
These tokens represent German masculine and neuter genitive and dative determiners and pronouns.
German modal and auxiliary verbs and their conjugated stems.
This vector represents negation and restrictive particles across Germanic languages.
This feature vector activates strongly on personal pronouns across different languages and grammatical cases.
This vector is related to German subordinating conjunctions and relative pronouns that introduce dependent clauses.
This vector represents the concept of Halloween, specifically centered around the phrase "Trick or Treat" and its semantic variations.
This feature vector represents tokens containing the German umlaut 'ä' and its linguistic variants.
This vector represents common two-letter consonantal and vocalic linguistic roots or prefixes, particularly involving liquid and plosive consonants.
This feature vector represents German words, linguistic prefixes, and morphological variations related to the roots for "lay" and "light/heavy".
